---
title: Get started
subtitle: From installation to a first result.
---

## Installation

```bash
pip install {{name}}
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Before you start
A callout: tinted, with a coloured bar. `.callout-tip`, `-warning` and `-important` change its colour.
:::

## A first example

```python
import {{name}}

result = {{name}}.run("input.txt", threads=4)
print(result.summary())
```

| Option | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--threads` | `1` | How many threads to use |
| `--out` | `out/` | Where results go |

Keys are drawn as keys: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> searches the site.
